full_judgment:
Bimalendu Bikash Roy Choudhury, J.: The suit out of which this petition has arisen was brought by the petitioner and respondent Nos. 2-7 against respondent No. 1 for redemption, recovery of Khas possession and also partition of the suit plot No. 4427 appertaining to RS Khatian No. 3080. 

 2. Respondent No.1 contested the suit contending, inter alia, that two other plots of the suit Khatian along with RS Khatian No. 3761 belonging to Gunu Mia, common ancestor of the parties, had not been brought into hotchpotch and so the suit was not maintainable. 

 4. Being aggrieved he moved the High Court Division in revision. A learned Single Judge of the High Court Division in consideration of RS Khatian Nos. 3080 and 3761 found that the suit was not maintainable for not bringing the entire property left by Gunu Mia into hotchpotch. Accordingly, he reversed the concurrent decrees of the first two Courts below and sent back the case on remand to the trial Court "for affording an opportunity to the plaintiffs to bring the ejmali properties left by Gunu Mia into hotchpotch and then to dispose of the suit in accordance with law."
